capabilities: Convert EPUB files into Markdown note folders
Import via command with a file path or from configured library paths
Customize note and asset paths with templates
Attach images and other assets from the EPUB
extras: Mobile is not supported due to .epub file handling limitations; Linux/Mac support is only lightly tested. Details live in a Wiki and an Example Vault rather than the README.
problem: Obsidian cannot open EPUB files, so ebooks stay outside the vault and cannot be read, highlighted, or linked with notes.
summary: EPUB importer that converts ebook files into folders of linked Markdown notes for reading and annotating in the vault.
